about: The evangelium of the formulary “Immaculate Heart of the Blessed Virgin Mary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, near the cross of Jesus there stood His mother, and the sister of His mother, Mary of Cleophas, and Mary Magdalene. So when Jesus had seen His mother and the disciple He loved standing there, He said to His mother: Woman, behold your son. Afterward He said to the disciple: Behold your mother. And the disciple, from that hour, received her among his own.
